# Agentic SEO
> LLM-first SEO and AEO/GEO analysis skill for AI coding assistants and autonomous agents.

## Project Overview
Agentic SEO equips coding assistants (Antigravity, Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf, Copilot, Codex, Cline) with 16 specialized SEO sub-skills, 10 specialist agents, and 89 automated evidence-collection scripts.

## Core Capabilities
- **Full Domain Audit (360°)**: Deep multi-signal analysis of technical SEO, performance, content, schema, links, and AI search visibility.
- **Generative Engine Optimization (GEO & AEO)**: Prepares web content to be indexed and cited accurately by ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.
- **Schema & Structured Data**: Validates and generates Schema.org JSON-LD (Product, Article, Organization, LocalBusiness, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList).
- **Technical SEO**: Inspects robots.txt, XML sitemaps, redirects, HTTP security headers, and Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP).
- **GitHub Repository SEO**: Audits repository metadata, topics, community health, and search rankings.
